# Hand-made fixtures for the material extraction scorer

Everything here was written by hand for `tests/test_materials_eval.py`: the school, its five pages,
the "extraction" in `requirements/fixture-school.json` and the labels in `gold.json`. None of it
describes a real school or program, and the numbers the tests compute from it measure nothing about
any extractor. No score is kept here: the tests write one to a temporary folder.
